com.atproto.server.createSession with the handle and app password as JSON body parameters; Bluesky answers the session (did, accessJwt)

reads.note: not asked in this variant: the item has no enclosure, so the node has no URL and n8n fails it before any request

expect.offline: The feed URL and the Bluesky handle and app password are placeholders in the template; the overlay fills them on both sides. In n8n's manual mode the RSS Feed Trigger reads the whole feed and emits only its first item (FIXTURES.md); trigger.items is that item as rss-parser gives it. Create Post's JSON body splices contentSnippet raw into a JSON string and reads link title from a misspelt field (lintitlek), so its embed title is empty on both sides by the template's own construction. With no enclosure, Download image has no URL.
